svg.title: HUB75 adapter to Raspberry Pi Pico wiring
svg.text: One Glance Mapping of HUB75 Connector → Raspberry Pico GPIOs
Pico pinout source: twisst, Pico-pinout-posters, CC0 1.0, https://github.com/twisst/Pico-pinout-posters
Control · clk_pin = GPIO 11 · strobe_pin = GPIO 12 · oen_pin = GPIO 13
Each pin group must be a continuous block in ascending order (required by the PIO program).
Common ground between adapter and Pico (any Pico GND pin works).
